findings.one_line: The reproduction gives the displayed limsup pointwise for each fixed local array and each covariance subsequence, but not uniformly over compact h (or arrays): ass:local-welfare-array is only pointwise and supplies no uniform convergence/rate, so diagonal arrays can delay convergence arbitrarily; weaken the statement to pointwise/subsequential form or add an explicit uniform local-array condition.

With fixed n0, binary W, and r_C -> r with positive coordinates, every normalized cluster summand is uniformly O(C^-1/2), which itself yields Lindeberg; the proof does not consume this separate estimator-side condition, so remove it or state a regime where boundedness/positive limiting rates do not already imply it.
